description: This file contains Redux action creators for channel-related operations in the Mattermost web application, including opening direct/group channels, loading channels, autocomplete functions, and notification settings.

methods.name: openDirectChannelToUserId
methods.description: Opens a direct message channel to a specified user ID, creating it if it doesn't exist, and updates user preferences.

methods.name: openGroupChannelToUserIds
methods.description: Creates a group channel with specified user IDs and navigates back if creation fails.

methods.name: loadChannelsForCurrentUser
methods.description: Loads all channels for the current user, including unread channels, and loads profiles for sidebar display.

methods.name: autocompleteChannels
methods.description: Performs channel autocomplete within the current team based on a search term.

methods.name: autocompleteActiveChannels
methods.description: Performs autocomplete for active (non-deleted) channels within the current team.

methods.name: autocompleteChannelsForSearch
methods.description: Performs channel autocomplete for search across the current team.

methods.name: autocompleteChannelsForSearchInTeam
methods.description: Performs channel autocomplete for search within a specified team.

methods.name: addUsersToChannel
methods.description: Adds multiple users to a specified channel.

methods.name: unmuteChannel
methods.description: Sets notification preferences to unmute a channel for a user.

methods.name: muteChannel
methods.description: Sets notification preferences to mute a channel for a user.
